task.description:
WF-03, step 8 (TEST-RUNNER) of run ISS-0093-20261028-01 after the PASS of the test gate (step 08p). Your task is to establish from the record of that run, with your OWN reading, whether the check passed, and to report PASS or FAIL with the real output. Do not run the full check yourself, do not run any heavy test here, do not push or create branches, do not edit project files except your own handoff.
Facts to verify (do not trust this text): the run id is 40968115867 (read it with `gh run view 40968115867 --json conclusion,headSha,status,jobs` and `gh run view 40968115867 --log`; the log is saved outside the project, you may re-read it with the same command). Its head commit was a snapshot of the working tree of that time (commit cfeffe0ec77eb41f2f2ab84a2c6f3397882f4897, parent 7132d17157cfe9e461a6a704b82d2f0584f104b7, made outside the working branch and not part of `main`; the objects may still be present locally: `git cat-file -t <sha>`; if not, say so). An earlier run, 40965967184 (commit 7132d17), was CANCELLED by the 15-minute limit of the workflow while the tests were still running, with 2030 tests ok and no `not ok`; that is why decisions/0106 raised the limit to 30 minutes (judge that decision as a fix of the process, not as a lowering of the quality bar).
Check: (1) the conclusion of run 40968115867 and of every step; the log shows format:check, lint, traces, handoffs-check and the tests each ran and passed, and the final counters (tests, pass, fail, cancelled, skipped, todo) - report them; count `not ok` lines; no test marked skip or todo; (2) the head commit really was the working tree of this run: if the snapshot commit object exists locally compare its tree with the working files for tools/ and .github/ (`git diff --stat <sha> -- tools .github`, an empty diff is expected), and for the rest of the files name any difference (handoffs and docs/program/public-v1/PROGRESS.md are expected to differ: they were written after the snapshot); if the object is absent, say what you could and could not confirm; (3) the 11 guard tests and the new tests of REQ-102 (team-result-bytes, team-result-timing) are in the run and ok, found by name in the log; (4) the time of the run (start to end) against the limit now in the workflow, and the time of the earlier green runs on main (`gh run list --workflow check.yml --branch main`); say how close to the limit it is; (5) whether the timing family of criterion 7 stayed green on the runner without a retry; (6) the second cancelled run and anything else red on that branch; (7) that the temporary branch is gone from the remote (`git ls-remote --heads origin`) and nothing else was pushed; (8) the local state is unchanged: HEAD 6f5a38a, `git status` only the files of this stage.
Then PASS (the check on GitHub was green on files equal to the working files) or FAIL with reasons. Say plainly in result.issues that the check ran on GitHub, not locally, and what that means for RELEASE-VALIDATOR (which must run or read the check again itself on the final files, and for RELEASE-FINALIZER the check on main is the next one). result.summary: two or three plain Russian sentences for the owner. No machine paths, no names of other projects, no secret-shaped literal in the handoff.

issues.text: IMPORTANT FOR THE NEXT STEPS: the check ran on GitHub (Linux, Node 22), not on this computer, on the owner's word of 2026-10-29, and not by me. What I did is read the record of that run and prove that the files of the run are the working files. This PASS is therefore a PASS of the GitHub run on files equal to the working files of this moment (except PROGRESS.md and handoffs written later). It does not carry over: RELEASE-VALIDATOR (step 9) must run the check itself or read the check on GitHub again on the FINAL files of the release (any edit after cfeffe0, including a change of PROGRESS.md-like bookkeeping that the tests read, makes this record old); for RELEASE-FINALIZER the check of workflow check on main after the push is the next one, and it must be waited for. Q2 and Q3 hold: a gate does not accept this report as its own run.

The time of the suite is at the edge of the old limit: 14 min 58 s of the job against 15 min before decision 0106 (the first attempt was cancelled by exactly this). Against the new limit of 30 minutes the margin is about 15 minutes. No defect is needed (nothing is red); the point is for ORCH and the audit: the growth of the suite is real (previous main run 14.7 min without REQ-102 tests), the 25-minute rule of decision 0106 is the signal for option C. The line 'запуск 3-5 минут' in docs/design/REQ-030-github-check.md is out of date, as decision 0106 says, and is for DOC-UPDATER.

No failure, no skip, no todo, no flaky test in this run, so no defect is needed from this step. The cancelled run 40965967184 was cancelled by the time limit of the workflow, not by a failing test (2030 ok, 0 not ok before the cancel). I judge the decision 0106 as a fix of the process: the same tests and thresholds, one number changed, the power to fail kept (Q10); it does not lower the quality bar.

Housekeeping, for honesty: the logs of the two runs were saved by me into the scratch folder of the session as run.log (run 40968115867) and run1.log (run 40965967184); a file with the name run1.log may have been there from an earlier save of the same kind and was replaced by the same log.
